_doc: Brawl: a free-for-all of 2 to 4 fighters, each on their own team with one life. Last one standing wins; at time, the healthiest. Spawns are fractions of the floor, one per slot. Chaos Cup plays these rules with three random mutators (data/rules/mutators.json) on top. Times are in ticks (60 per second) unless named _seconds. Shrines ("shrines", over data/rules/shrines.json): one in the middle that a fighter claims alone, haste then might, first ready 12 s in, then every 25 s.
